subject: QA: zonoid — start_task claim gate (DG1/DG2 session_id) breaks 11 existing test suites
description:
Nightly QA (watermark 2026-06-12→2026-06-15) found 11 test suites newly failing, all in the start_task/claim path. Reproducible across both full `./scripts/qa-suite.sh` runs.

REPRO: cd /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid && ./scripts/qa-suite.sh   (or run an individual suite, e.g. `node test/force-claim-cap.test.js`)

ROOT CAUSE (suspect): DG1 (local/dg1) made POST /overlay/status in_progress resolve session_id and now returns 400 when session_id is missing + 409 for dispatcher/non-subagent sessions, BEFORE applying the claim. DG2 (local/dg2) added session_id to the start_task MCP schema + pass-through. DG1/DG2 added NEW tests (mcp-harness-tools, classify-endpoint) but did NOT update these ~11 EXISTING claim tests, which claim without a session_id and now get 400/409 instead of 200/409-as-expected. Incomplete-migration regression: the suite is red.

EVIDENCE (bounded):
- force-claim-cap: "normal claim 1: 200" → AssertionError 400 !== 200
- dispatcher-model: "subagent start_task → ok" false !== true
- app-restart: "(A) claim accepted (200)" FAIL (cascades to all in_progress/restart asserts)
- unwired-quarantine: "claim of unwired task refused with 409" FAIL (session gate 400s before quarantine check)
- endpoints: "subagent claim lands after mark-root" AssertionError

AFFECTED SUITES (11): app-restart, dispatcher-model, endpoints, filedrop-daemon, force-claim-cap, metric-branch-claim, newly-ready, phase2-integration, should-stop-advisory, touch-agent, unwired-quarantine.

SUSPECT DELTA TASKS: local/dg1, local/dg2, 091a4bf1.../20 (touchAgent agent_tool_spawn), 091a4bf1.../29 (unify worker registration), 3875ca4b.../2 (force-claim hard cap), local/b3 (metric-branch invariant at claim).

FIX DIRECTION (morning decides — DO NOT fix at night): either (a) update the 11 existing claim tests to pass session_id through start_task/POST body, or (b) if the gate is too strict for legitimate callers, soften the 400 path. Likely (a) — tests not migrated alongside DG1/DG2.
